extracted.intended_audience: fiction writers seeking craft guidance for story openings
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for crafting story openings that begin in medias res — dropping the reader into the middle of action and revealing backstory later through dialogue, flashback, or contextual revelation to maintain momentum and curiosity.

rubrics_metrics.name: In medias res (definition)
rubrics_metrics.description: A story-opening technique that drops the reader into the midst of action, with backstory filled in later through dialogue, flashback, or contextual revelation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Open in the middle of events rather than at chronological beginning; plan ways to reveal necessary backstory later rather than front-loading exposition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open at a climactic/active moment
rubrics_metrics.description: Open at a climactic moment, conflict, argument, fight, or revelation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose a moment that already has tension or movement so the opening immediately generates momentum and stakes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trust the reader to catch up
rubrics_metrics.description: Trust the reader to catch up.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid spelling out every detail; allow readers to infer context from action and dialogue, filling in gaps over time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Withhold backstory until it's earned
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reveal past information only when it serves the present scene or when the payoff justifies interrupting momentum.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use flashbacks sparingly
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you use flashbacks, make them purposeful and necessary; overuse undermines immediacy and can stall narrative forward motion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Let dialogue carry exposition
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Embed contextual details and backstory in natural-sounding dialogue rather than in long expository paragraphs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid over-explaining early
rubrics_metrics.description: Avoid the temptation to over-explain in the second paragraph.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resist explaining too much too soon; preserve the information deficit that pulls readers forward.

rubrics_metrics.name: Generate immediate momentum and information deficit
rubrics_metrics.description: The opening should generate immediate momentum and create an information deficit that pulls the reader forward.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aim for implicit world-building via context, compress the apparent timeline (much has already happened off-page), and avoid 'boring openings.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid action without stakes
rubrics_metrics.description: Action without stakes (we don't care because we don't know who's involved).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the opening's action has clear stakes or personal relevance so readers care about the outcome and the participants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid confusing without rewarding
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide enough anchor points and later payoff so confusion becomes curiosity; if confusion persists with no reward, readers will abandon the story.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid dumping exposition after the opening
rubrics_metrics.description: Exposition dumped in chapter 2 to 'catch them up'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Don't solve the information deficit by dumping backstory in the next chapter; instead integrate reveals so they serve the present action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid generic, nonspecific action openings
rubrics_metrics.description: Generic action-movie opening with no specificity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make the action specific to characters, voice, and setting; avoid clichés and anonymous spectacle that fail to connect to the story's stakes or themes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hook the reader quickly
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A successful in medias res opening captures interest almost immediately—use voice, tension, or mystery so the reader is invested by the second paragraph.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evoke curiosity rather than confusion
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Calibrate how much you withhold so readers feel intrigued and eager to learn more, not lost or alienated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reveal backstory in service of present scene
rubrics_metrics.description: Backstory revealed in service of present scene.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All retrospective information should illuminate current stakes, character choices, or thematic resonance rather than functioning as isolated history.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make the opening moment load-bearing
rubrics_metrics.description: The opening moment turns out to be load-bearing for the whole story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the event or revelation you open on has consequences or thematic weight that justify its centrality to the narrative arc.
